title: Disparities in LLM Reasoning Accuracy and Explanations: A Case Study on African American English

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM reasoning disparities by prompting models with equivalent multiple-choice questions in Standard American English (SAE) and African American English (AAE), and comparing the resulting answer accuracy, explanation readability (via Flesch Reading Ease Score), output consistency, and psychological expressions (using LIWC).
